text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice of the Breastfed Infant). The total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL with a normal direct bilirubin (0.7 mg/dL) indicates unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, and the absence of pale stools or dark urine rules out biliary obstruction. The infant is stable with normal weight gain, making this a common case of prolonged jaundice associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
